_note: Canonical benchmark dataset for benchmarks.smithers.sh. Public SOTA rows are from the benchmarks' own papers/leaderboards; smithers rows are the Claude-only (Opus->Sonnet delegation) fleet and are PENDING until the first full cloud pass. Every row carries n + subset + caveat so a small/pending run can never imply a full-benchmark claim. Design: .smithers/specs/cloud-benchmark-fleet.md.

benchmarks.name: SWE-Bench Pro
benchmarks.headline: 731 multi-file tasks across 11 professional repos (Go/Python/JS/TS), hidden tests in canonical per-instance Docker.

benchmarks.name: RoadmapBench
benchmarks.headline: Long-horizon multi-target version upgrades (median ~3,700 LOC / ~51 files); the best single agent on the official board resolves under 40%.

benchmarks.name: Claw-Eval-Live
benchmarks.headline: Agentic enterprise workflows scored on observable execution evidence; no public model clears the 70% pass bar.

leaderboard.caveat: cannot run faithfully Claude-only (native OpenAI gather leg + neutral Gemini judge); asterisked variant only

benchmarks.name: SWE-EVO
benchmarks.headline: Carry a Python project across a whole release transition; frontier agents resolve only ~21-25% (full-48).

leaderboard.caveat: Claude-only fleet run pending; dvc subset is easier than full-48, not directly comparable
